text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ta-da-da-daaa! Pa-pa-pa-paaah!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for the long-awaited 
results announcement, Trainer!
choice_data_list: What is it all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What else could it be? It's the results of 
our goal—gathering fans.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
First, you must draw attention, otherwise 
there's little point in running in the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Someone like me could never, 
ever, ever run in the Classic Triple 
Crown, though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fans are super important... That much... I 
understand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mm. I've already told my fans to gather in 
the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you successfully gathered enough fans— 
A packed house of fans will give you a 
standing ovation!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
On the flip side, if we fail, not a soul 
will show up! It'll end up no different 
from the year-end party.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will emerge—a god, or a devil!? 
Will a legion of fans welcome them, or 
none at all!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The door of destiny—open!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-CLATTER-CLANK!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Opera O. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The number of fans was... modest. The 
applause was modest as well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, what's this...?! A big bang eruption 
of applause that could tear the roof off!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, it wouldn't be an 
exaggeration to say we've completely 
captivated the entire world, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exaggeration aside, with a crowd like 
this, she should draw quite a bit of 
attention in the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we've decided our 
strategy for entering the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye, gathered fans! Lend me 
your ears!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, TM Opera O's declaration of intent 
began.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The magnificent curtain has risen! My goal 
is to overthrow the previous generation 
and claim a "changing of the guard"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to do that, I must first 
make my presence known in the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The road will not be easy. In the Classic 
races, that formidable rival will likely 
stand in our way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet I will not lose! As the Supreme 
Sovereign, I shall fight with honor and 
claim victory over them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Um... who is that person!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Who? Who is it, Opera O!?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And just who is that person?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Who is it, Trainer-kun? Please, do tell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something blurted out in the heat of the 
moment was tossed back to me with absolute 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's still too early to tell who the top 
contenders are for this year's Classic. 
Off the top of my head...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's impossible~. The Classics are... I 
probably won't even make it to the 
starting line~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, now is not the time to stand still. 
Dream of the future and close your eyes to 
reality.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you step forward, the appearance of an 
unknown performer will surely cause a 
magnificent stir!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, my worthy rival Doto. My impromptu 
villain! Take my hand and onto the stage! 
Come, come!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto panicked, flustered and 
confused...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What should I do~? She's inviting 
me... That Opera O-san is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The one I look up to... But I'm... so 
weak... Auugghhhhh~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want... to try... But... but... 
Surely... no, absolutely...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry~! There's no waaaay I can do 
this~~~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto ended up running away. It 
seems pushing her so hard was a mistake 
after all...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Refusing my hand...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, could it be that I was so 
charming it actually intimidated them...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still, I am not one to lose my way over 
something of this measure. Indeed, this 
too is merely foreshadowing for the grand 
opera.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! As for my formidable 
nemesis... just who that might be is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Watch the Satsuki Sho, and you'll 
understand! Let's meet again among the 
fresh greenery of Nakayama, where our 
opening strikes will clash!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I somehow managed to dodge the question...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, please arrange a rival for me 
by the main event. An extraordinary one, 
if you will.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... an impossible demand was thrown my 
way...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, Opera O-san... Even though you went 
out of your way to reach out a helping 
hand to me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I'm so weak... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Things became quite chaotic, but T.M. 
Opera O successfully won over fans."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That glorious path—led straight to the 
Satsuki Sho.
